Thanks for reaching out to Grow Green. Our team will review your property details and contact you about your lawn fertilization and weed control estimate. This is a quote request, not a scheduled treatment.
We start with the grass, weeds, sunlight, and moisture conditions. Tell us about thin spots or areas that stay wet so we can look beyond color alone.
We feed when your grass can use the nutrients. Weed prevention and targeted treatments work alongside nutrition, with products selected for the turf and conditions.
Each visit helps us track the lawn’s response. We adjust care as conditions change, watch for insect and disease concerns, and leave useful notes for watering, mowing, and aftercare.
Care through South Louisiana’s seasons
Warm-season turf moves through active growth, heat stress, and slower winter growth. Our LaPlace lawn program responds to that cycle, with applications guided by the grass and weather.
Time feeding to active growth, address early weeds, and use preventive treatments at appropriate seasonal windows.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for heat, moisture, and turf response while monitoring seasonal insect activity.
Shift nutrition as growth slows, manage cool-season weed pressure, and watch for seasonal disease concerns.
Monitor lawn conditions and winter weeds. Dormant warm-season grass does not need the same nitrogen feeding as actively growing summer turf.
This is an overview of seasonal priorities. Actual products, rates, and visit timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass. Match the care.
The amount of fertilizer that suits one lawn can be too much for another. We consider grass type, sunlight, moisture, and mowing so nutrition supports the lawn you actually have.
Learn more: LSU AgCenter’s Louisiana Lawn Maintenance guide (PDF) and UF/IFAS centipedegrass guidance .
Local ownership. A personal standard.

Grow Green is a firefighter-owned lawn-treatment company based in St. Amant, serving homeowners in LaPlace and across our South Louisiana service area. Dereck built the company around thoughtful lawn care and straightforward communication.

You get a clear estimate, service notes after treatments, and an office you can contact when something needs attention. If a concern appears between visits, reach out so we can review it and explain the next step.
LaPlace is part of our St. John the Baptist Parish service area. Enter your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability and prepare your estimate.
In a nearby River Parishes community? Send your address and our team will check coverage for your property.

Clear answers before you start
What LaPlace homeowners ask about lawn treatments, pricing, and the care that happens between visits.

Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. The season, weather, and turf condition guide each application. The visits serve different purposes through the year; they are not eight identical fertilizer applications.

Your price depends on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. We provide a free estimate before you approve. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments.

Yes. The lawn program includes seasonally timed weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. We choose products for your grass, the weed species, and the conditions. Persistent weeds may need continued management or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

We care for warm-season lawns including centipede, St. Augustine, Bermuda, and zoysia. Nutrition and weed-control choices depend on the grass and property conditions. If you are unsure which grass you have, include that in your estimate request.

We provide lawn treatments in LaPlace as part of our St. John the Baptist Parish service area. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your property. If you are in a nearby River Parishes community, our team can check that address too.

Weed response and turf improvement depend on the species, growing conditions, and condition of the lawn. Some changes appear sooner than others; thin turf needs time and suitable growing conditions to fill in. We explain what to expect and review progress through the program rather than promise the same result in a fixed number of days.

Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. After the visit, we provide service notes and directions for caring for the treated lawn.

Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

Follow the instructions provided with that visit. Watering and mowing timing depend on the products applied and the conditions. If you are unsure, contact our office before changing the aftercare plan.

Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.

structured.hero_sub: Give your lawn a plan for healthier growth and fewer weeds. Grow Green brings seasonal nutrition, targeted weed control, and consistent attention to LaPlace lawns—with care matched to your grass and property.
structured.local_title: One lawn program. A plan for every season.
structured.local_lead: The amount of fertilizer that suits one lawn can be too much for another. We consider grass type, sunlight, moisture, and mowing so nutrition supports the lawn you actually have.

features.title: Understand the lawn
features.body: We start with the grass, weeds, sunlight, and moisture conditions. Tell us about thin spots or areas that stay wet so we can look beyond color alone.

features.title: Apply with purpose
features.body: We feed when your grass can use the nutrients. Weed prevention and targeted treatments work alongside nutrition, with products selected for the turf and conditions.

features.title: Keep care responsive
features.body: Each visit helps us track the lawn’s response. We adjust care as conditions change, watch for insect and disease concerns, and leave useful notes for watering, mowing, and aftercare.

real_faqs.q: How often do you treat lawns in LaPlace?
real_faqs.a: Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. The season, weather, and turf condition guide each application. The visits serve different purposes through the year; they are not eight identical fertilizer applications.

real_faqs.q: How much does lawn fertilization cost?
real_faqs.a: Your price depends on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. We provide a free estimate before you approve. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments.

real_faqs.q: Is weed control included with fertilization?
real_faqs.a: Yes. The lawn program includes seasonally timed weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. We choose products for your grass, the weed species, and the conditions. Persistent weeds may need continued management or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

real_faqs.q: Which grass types do you treat?
real_faqs.a: We care for warm-season lawns including centipede, St. Augustine, Bermuda, and zoysia. Nutrition and weed-control choices depend on the grass and property conditions. If you are unsure which grass you have, include that in your estimate request.

real_faqs.q: Do you serve my LaPlace address?
real_faqs.a: We provide lawn treatments in LaPlace as part of our St. John the Baptist Parish service area. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your property. If you are in a nearby River Parishes community, our team can check that address too.

real_faqs.q: How soon will my lawn look better?
real_faqs.a: Weed response and turf improvement depend on the species, growing conditions, and condition of the lawn. Some changes appear sooner than others; thin turf needs time and suitable growing conditions to fill in. We explain what to expect and review progress through the program rather than promise the same result in a fixed number of days.

real_faqs.q: Do I need to be home for treatment?
real_faqs.a: Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. After the visit, we provide service notes and directions for caring for the treated lawn.

real_faqs.q: When can children and pets return to the lawn?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

real_faqs.q: Should I water or mow after an application?
real_faqs.a: Follow the instructions provided with that visit. Watering and mowing timing depend on the products applied and the conditions. If you are unsure, contact our office before changing the aftercare plan.

real_faqs.q: Will fertilizer fix yellow grass or bare spots?
real_faqs.a: Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.
